$comment: Cases both editors must judge alike. Each case is a source and the issues expected for it, sorted by start, end and code; offsets count UTF-16 code units. An issue without start and end is checked by code only: the two JavaScript parsers do not always place a syntax error on the same character. fixes holds the whole source after each quick fix, in the order offered. The severity and message, where a case gives them, are checked as well. A case may give prefix, the attribute prefix of an aliased bundle, which is data- otherwise. A case may also say what the host knows of the project: htmlDsl, true or false, whether streamlord-html is on the classpath, which the file's imports decide otherwise; core, false when streamlord-core is not; and foreign, the names of calls that are not Streamlord's, which the harness turns into where each call of those names starts, as the scanner finds the calls. The same source under different options sits side by side, so a cache that ignores the options fails.
